Diyaar · Kuwait · via Upwork

A quality document portal where every change is reviewed, approved and tracked

The problem

Quality documents for several companies were scattered, and every new or changed document needed approvals that were hard to follow by email.

What I built

A SharePoint portal with a library for each company, a request and approval workflow and management dashboards, plus staff attendance and an events hub.

  • SharePoint Online
  • Power Automate
  • Approval workflows
  • Dashboards

  1. One home for every team

    Company libraries, a New Request button and each person's pending tasks on one page.

  2. Submit and track requests

    A searchable list shows every document request, its division and which review stage it's at.

  3. Reviews that move on their own

    Each request goes to the first reviewer, then the second, and ends approved or rejected, with every step in the right person's task list.

  4. Dashboards for management

    Task volume, pending, rejected and approved requests, obsolete documents, and documents by type and division.

Appgenix · Power Apps

An ICT risk register with guided entry, automatic scoring and multi-stage approvals

The problem

Technology risks were logged in spreadsheets and rated differently by different people, and approvals were chased by email, so no one could see where a risk stood.

What I built

A Power Apps canvas app backed by SharePoint and Power Automate: a guided two-step form, automatic likelihood × impact scoring, an approval route through the risk owner and the SAARC team, and a dashboard for every user, in light and dark mode.

  • Power Apps
  • Power Automate
  • SharePoint
  • Approval workflow
  • Dashboards

  1. Log a risk in a guided form

    Two steps capture the risk, its causes, effects, key controls, actions and owner. Every rating field links to its reference table, so people pick the right value.

  2. Scoring done for you

    Likelihood and impact are each scored 1 to 5 and multiplied into a rating band, from Low (1–5) to Extreme (21–25).

  3. Approvals that route themselves

    Every request moves through these stages, with a live tracker on each one:

    1. Request created
    2. With risk owner
    3. With SAARC team
    4. Risk registered

    Approvers see everything waiting on them in one screen, and can put a request on hold, ask for more information, decline or cancel it.

  4. A dashboard for every user

    Risks by status, review dates that are due or overdue, pending requests by rating and by approval stage, and submissions over the last seven days.
